title: Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2610.32802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student's learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for gui

translated_title: Frontier-OPD：发现智能体能力的边界并教会智能体去超越
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏使教师反馈与学生当前行为保持一致，然而为多轮智能体获取有用的监督信号，需要同时确定何处需要指导，以及学生在此之后能否维持交互。我们提出 Frontier-OPD，它通过学生的学习边界来解决这一问题：学习边界指那些仍然具有挑战性、但在接受简短教师指导后能够进行有用的自主延续的决策情境。为了将该边界可操作化，Frontier-OPD 将在策略经验组织成一个共享状态轨迹图，其中通过轨迹平衡的方式聚合师生分歧，识别出不同的干预候选点，同时保留回放所需的历史信息。随后，通过将教师桥接段及随后的学生延续段上的一致性，与原始轨迹中等长的片段进行比较，来评估简短教师桥接段，为指导价值提供行为代理指标。
tldr: Frontier-OPD 通过“学习边界”概念——即经简短教师指导后学生仍能自主有效延续的挑战性决策情境——并借助共享状态轨迹图和师生分歧的轨迹平衡聚合来定位干预点，从而发现多轮智能体的能力边界并教会其超越。
en_tdlr: Frontier-OPD discovers the edge of agent capability by targeting the student's learning frontier—challenging decision situations that support useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance—using a shared-state trajectory graph with trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement to identify optimal intervention points for on-policy distillation of multi-turn agents.
